specs.title: Current Finance (Pebble Protocol) - Sui Move Lending Protocol

sub_graphs.name: Enter Market
invariants: INV-001: Circuit breaker prevents new obligations when market is halted
INV-002: emode_group must exist in registry before obligation creation
INV-003: Each obligation gets a unique ObligationOwnerCap as proof of ownership
INV-004: Obligation is a shared object; cap is the access proof
INV-005: emode_group is immutable once obligation is created

sub_graphs.name: Deposit
invariants: INV-001: ctoken_amount = deposit_amount / exchange_rate
INV-002: exchange_rate = (cash + borrows - reserves) / total_supply
INV-003: total_ctoken_amount reflects post-deposit balance for obligation
INV-004: Liquidity mining rewards updated atomically with deposit
INV-005: Cannot deposit asset that is already borrowed by same obligation

sub_graphs.name: Borrow
invariants: INV-001: Only assets from obligation's emode group can be borrowed
INV-002: Borrow index always monotonically increases
INV-003: Borrowing a collateral asset is forbidden (would corrupt bookkeeping)
INV-004: Risk level = total_debt_value / total_collateral_value must be < 1 after borrow
INV-005: Oracle price must pass EMA/spot diff tolerance check
INV-006: min_borrow_amount enforced after each borrow to prevent dust positions

sub_graphs.name: Withdraw As Coin
invariants: INV-001: Health factor must remain below 1.0 (fully collateralized) after withdrawal
INV-002: withdraw_amount = exchange_rate * ctoken_to_burn
INV-003: ctokens_remaining = obligation's ctoken balance after burn
INV-004: Oracle prices consulted to verify collateral sufficiency post-withdrawal
INV-005: Only obligation owner (via cap) can withdraw their collateral

sub_graphs.name: Repay
invariants: INV-001: Interest accrued before repay to ensure accurate debt calculation
INV-002: Repay can be on behalf of any obligation (repay_on_behalf)
INV-003: Overpayment results in refund; excess treated as protocol donation
INV-004: Remaining debt must meet min_borrow_amount or be zero (fully repaid)
INV-005: Debt record removed from WitTable when debt cleared completely

sub_graphs.name: Liquidate
invariants: INV-001: Soft liquidation - repay capped so risk level returns to exactly 1.0 after liquidation
INV-002: close_factor limits max repay per transaction
INV-003: close_factor_bypass_min_value allows full liquidation for small positions
INV-004: protocol_seize_amount = liq_revenue_factor * collateral_value goes to cash_reserve
INV-005: liquidator_seize_amount = collateral_value - protocol_seize_amount
INV-006: Liquidation requires PackageCallerCap with liquidation permission

sub_graphs.name: Flash Loan Lifecycle
invariants: INV-001: Flash loan amount must be < cash (not <=), reserves can be borrowed
INV-002: FlashLoan hot potato enforces mandatory repayment within same PTB
INV-003: Flash loan does NOT increase reserve.debt (not a regular borrow)
INV-004: Exact principal amount must be repaid; fees are additional
INV-005: Fee goes entirely to cash_reserve (protocol revenue)
INV-006: emode_group determines flash loan fee rate (fee tied to emode per design)

sub_graphs.name: Accrue Interest
invariants: INV-001: Interest accrual is idempotent within a single timestamp (skip if last_updated == now)
INV-002: Borrow index is monotonically non-decreasing (enforced by set_value assertion)
INV-003: Simple interest model: new_index = index_prior * (1 + rate * dt)
INV-004: reserve_factor portion of interest goes to protocol reserve (not lenders)
INV-005: cash_reserve grows with each accrue; represents protocol-owned share

sub_graphs.name: Obligation Deposit Ctoken
invariants: INV-001: A single CoinType cannot be both collateral and debt in same obligation
INV-002: This invariant must hold even under flash loan reentrancy (per contest spec)
INV-003: First deposit of a CoinType initializes collateral tracking entry
INV-004: Subsequent deposits of same CoinType just join the balance

sub_graphs.name: Liquidate Adl
invariants: INV-001: ADL requires distinct adl_permission (separate from normal liquidation permission)
INV-002: ADL used for bad debt scenarios where normal liquidation is insufficient
INV-003: ADLBorrow reduces obligation debt without seizing proportional collateral
INV-004: ADLCollateral seizes collateral to cover bad debt
INV-005: Both ADL paths share same post-liquidation event emission and reward update logic
